name: Springwise

sources.title: Springwise — live innovation-intelligence platform; nav exposes 'Submit an Innovation' under Resources; 'Register for free' vs 'Become a member' tiers; editorially curated database (~50 verified innovations/week); contact info@springwise.com

conditions: 'Submit an Innovation' exists as a public route, but inclusion is editorially curated — Springwise is a paid innovation-intelligence platform for corporate subscribers; submitting gets your innovation considered, not listed
requirements: An innovation with an impact/sustainability lens — Springwise covers 'real-world solutions shaping the future' across circular economy, clean energy, regenerative agriculture, etc.
The 'Submit an Innovation' page under Resources (submitting is free; review is editorial)
Database entries are 'editorially reviewed… not raw data dumps' — human editors have final say
Consumption side is subscription/membership — your audience is innovation professionals, not consumers
preparation: A pitch framed around the innovation and its impact — Springwise covers 'innovations', not product launches
Sustainability/impact angle strongly favored — every entry is 'tagged through a sustainability lens'
workflow: Use Resources > 'Submit an Innovation' (or contact info@springwise.com)
Provide the innovation story: what it is, who built it, the impact claim
If selected, it enters the editorially curated innovation database — visible to member subscribers
watchFor: Curated editorial database — most submissions won't be covered; there's no guaranteed listing
Audience is corporate innovation/R&D/sustainability teams — consumer SaaS is a poor fit
The database itself is largely member-gated — your listing's public visibility may be limited
Free reader registration exists separate from the submit route
countsAsLive: The innovation has a curated entry in the Springwise database (and possibly a free-to-read article)
unknowns: How much of an innovation entry is public vs member-gated
